profile.headline: Full stack Developer
profile.summary:
Microsoft certified Azure .Net Architect having 14 years of software engineering experience in all phases of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) such as architecture definition, architecture review,  technical scope definition, design, deployment. 
Excellent technical skills in Azure resources, ASP.NET, Power Platform and Microsoft Cognitive Services.
Good exposure to web application design and development using Angular, Vue.js, HTML5, JQUERY, Bootstrap. 
Hands on experience in design and implementation of application in Azure environment (Kubernetes, Azure Functions, gateways and storage). 
Experience in Data Analytics and Visualization using Power BI.
Implementation experience for CICD pipeline with Azure DevOps and Octopus.
Excellence with Global delivery model and agile software development.
